exact: mRNA export from cell nucleus during heat stress
related: mRNA export from nucleus during heat stress

definition: The directed movement of mRNA from the nucleus to the cytoplasm during a heat stimulus, a temperature stimulus above the optimal temperature for the organism; in particular, a process that enables an organism withstand exposure to temperatures that would otherwise lethally impair poly(A)+ mRNA-nucleus export.
label: mRNA export from nucleus in response to heat stress
